problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign a set of freight parcels to identical cargo aircraft for an airlift operation. The parcels are as follows:

* Parcel Alpha: mass 35 metric tons
* Parcel Bravo: mass 41 metric tons
* Parcel Charlie: mass 30 metric tons
* Parcel Delta: mass 65 metric tons
* Parcel Echo: mass 67 metric tons
* Parcel Foxtrot: mass 64 metric tons
* Parcel Golf: mass 59 metric tons
* Parcel Hotel: mass 65 metric tons
* Parcel India: mass 60 metric tons
* Parcel Juliet: mass 47 metric tons
* Parcel Kilo: mass 41 metric tons
* Parcel Lima: mass 30 metric tons
* Parcel Mike: mass 57 metric tons
* Parcel November: mass 52 metric tons
* Parcel Oscar: mass 49 metric tons
* Parcel Papa: mass 57 metric tons
* Parcel Quebec: mass 33 metric tons
* Parcel Romeo: mass 32 metric tons
* Parcel Sierra: mass 32 metric tons
* Parcel Tango: mass 45 metric tons
* Parcel Uniform: mass 57 metric tons
* Parcel Victor: mass 35 metric tons
* Parcel Whiskey: mass 32 metric tons
* Parcel X-ray: mass 54 metric tons
* Parcel Yankee: mass 60 metric tons
* Parcel Zulu: mass 68 metric tons
* Parcel [Bracket]: mass 43 metric tons
* Parcel [Backslash]: mass 37 metric tons
* Parcel [BracketClose]: mass 47 metric tons
* Parcel [Caret]: mass 31 metric tons
* Parcel [Underscore]: mass 41 metric tons
* Parcel [Grave]: mass 60 metric tons
* Parcel a: mass 68 metric tons
* Parcel b: mass 33 metric tons
* Parcel c: mass 34 metric tons
* Parcel d: mass 31 metric tons

Each aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 100 metric tons. The coordinator must load all parcels, using the fewest possible aircraft. Every parcel must be placed on exactly one aircraft, and the total mass loaded onto any single aircraft must not exceed its payload limit.
